pages.title: The Netherite Monstrosity
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Soul Black Smith: the Netherite Monstrosity's horn and helm, its infernal forge and the void forge, the lava power cell, the netherite effigy and the little ministrosity.$(br2)$(thing)Industry$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(thing)48 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After The Ender Guardian.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill the Netherite Monstrosity$(n)$(br2)Pays 9 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
